model_description: Physical Intelligence pi0.5 (PI0.5) vision-language-action flow-matching policy. SigLIP-27 vision tower + Gemma-2B VLM + Gemma-300M adaRMS action expert + flow-matching denoiser.
device_note: Target is a single Blackhole device (P150). Physical host has 4x Blackhole p300c boards; tests open a single-device mesh (device fixture).
integration_path_rationale: pi0.5 is a lerobot/openpi checkpoint, NOT a transformers AutoModel. No HF Pi05ForConditionalGeneration class exists. Golden reference = reference/torch_*.py plain classes (hold raw weight tensors). Recipe/Auto API does not apply.
validation_sample: Vision-language-action: 3x (224x224x3) images + tokenized language+state prompt -> 50x32 action chunk via 10-step flow-matching denoise. Semantic check: output finite (no NaN/inf), correct shape (1,50,32), and E2E PCC vs torch reference >= 0.95 (reference achieves mean 0.991 over 10 seeds).

FULLY IMPLEMENTED (functionality-first, interleaved): GemmaMLP, GemmaAttention (fused QKV + nlp_create_qkv_heads + meta-RoPE + SDPA + KV cache), GemmaBlock, AdaRMSGemmaBlock (chunked modulation + gated residuals), SigLIP attention/MLP/block/tower + projector, suffix (action_in/out_proj, adarms_cond sincos->silu->mlp->silu), prefix embed concat, backbone embed_image/embed_language/forward_vlm/forward_expert. SCAFFOLDED (raise NotImplementedError w/ exact reference file:line, to implement+validate in pcc loop once weights land): top-level sample_actions denoise loop + host mask building; prefix pad/att-mask construction; SigLIP position-embedding bicubic interpolation (only for non-256-patch resolutions). Integration path manual: NOT added to _RECIPE_BEARING_SUBPACKAGES (no @register_recipe; pi05 is not a transformers AutoModel).

tier3.details: Backbone forward_vlm (18-layer Gemma-2B VLM) PASS on P150 with REAL pi05_base weights (14.5GB checkpoint loads + runs at scale via the from_torch tree).

tier4.details: END-TO-END sample_actions on P150 with real weights: SigLIP vision -> Gemma-2B VLM prefill -> 10-step flow-matching denoise (Gemma-300M adaRMS expert) -> (1,50,32) action chunk. TTNN vs torch reference (shared noise) E2E action PCC = 0.9960. Semantic gate PASS (finite, correct shape, non-degenerate). Implemented the denoise loop + suffix RoPE position-offset + phantom-suffix SDPA mask in modeling_pi05.py (replaced the scaffold).

op_sweep.notes: Swept the dominant op (Gemma-300M expert GeGLU MLP, runs 18 layers x 10 steps/chunk): weight_dtype {bfloat16, bfloat8_b} x math_fidelity {LoFi, HiFi2, HiFi4} = 6 configs, PCC vs fp32 + latency on P150. ALL configs PCC >= 0.9995. bfloat8_b/HiFi2 is Pareto-optimal (122.3us, PCC 0.99979) -- statistically tied with bfloat16 on latency here but half the DRAM bandwidth.

tracy_profiling.notes: Real tracy op-level device profile (python -m tracy, 10 denoise steps + 1 prefill, 6103 kernels). Matmul 69.6% / non-matmul 30.4% of device time. CSV + tt-perf-report saved.

full_model_signposted_profile.note: Full pi0.5 inference profiled with tracy signposts. VLM prefill (54.5ms) and the 10-step denoise loop (49.6ms) are the two dominant phases (~equal); SigLIP vision 14.1ms. tt-perf-report segmented per phase via --start-signpost/--end-signpost in perf_report_full.txt.

perf_analysis.notes: Matmul ranking (per-op avg): VLM MLP 288x2048x16384=1066us (fixed/prefill, biggest single cost); SigLIP fc2 256x4320x1152=171us; EXPERT MLP down 64x4096x1024=64us (slowest expert op), o 64x2048x1024=31us, qkv 64x1024x2560=23us, gate/up 64x1024x4096=22us. Non-matmul (30%): SDPA 8.1ms, BinaryNg(add/mul) 6.4ms over 2310 ops, LayerNorm/RMSNorm 6.4ms, NlpCreateHeads 6.4ms (26us avg), NLPConcatHeads 6.1ms (25us), RotaryEmbedding 5.8ms, Unary(silu/gelu) 3.7ms. Attention glue (heads+RoPE) is the dominant non-matmul cost.

config_optimize.notes: PERF PASS (tracy-driven). APPLIED: 1D width-shard core_grid (1 core row) on the small-M expert matmuls -- micro-bench validated down 64x4096x1024 67->29us (2.3x), o 35->22us (1.6x), qkv 25->21us (1.2x), PCC>=0.9998; gate/up kept on default 2D grid (1D was slower). Applied via core_grid= on MLP down_proj + attention QKV/o (guarded to seq<=96 so VLM prefill keeps the 2D grid). SDPA: micro-benched program configs (chunk sizes) -- DEFAULT heuristic is already fastest (47us; explicit configs 51-59us), so NO SDPA change. Head-split env flags (QWEN_NLP_*): no-op on our code path (no change). Result: traced denoise step 6.02->5.01ms (-17%); full chunk eager 156->142ms. Tier-4 E2E PCC preserved (0.9961). All 20 tests pass. | OP-SWEEP ROUND 2 (dtype x fidelity x core_grid on prefill matmuls): VLM down_proj 288x16384x2048 -> FULL 2D grid (509->225us, PCC0.9999); SigLIP fc2 256x4320x1152 -> FULL grid (173->57us, 3x, PCC0.9998); made Gemma-MLP down_proj grid SEQ-CONDITIONAL (row for expert M<=96, full for VLM M=288 -- the prior blanket row-grid had REGRESSED VLM down to 804us). Confirmed-optimal (no change): VLM gate/up 288x2048x16384 default bf8_b (bf16+default catastrophic 10ms), SigLIP fc1 default, expert gate/up default, expert down row. Re-profiled: SigLIP 14.1->10.8ms (-23%), VLM prefill 54.5->49.6ms (-9%). Full chunk eager 142->135ms. Tier-4 PCC 0.9963. 20/20 tests pass.

sharded_l1_investigation.outcome: NOT APPLIED (op-by-op sharding regresses; PCC fine but slower).
sharded_l1_investigation.root_cause: Per-op interleaved<->block-sharded to_memory_config conversion dominates for these tensor sizes; sharding only nets out if activations stay RESIDENT sharded across many consecutive ops (reference forward_bs: convert once, 27 SigLIP layers sharded, convert back once). Small-M expert (2 tiles) also can't divide a 2D block grid.
sharded_l1_investigation.decision: Keep validated core_grid + interleaved-L1 configs. The only viable sharded-L1 win is a full resident-sharded SigLIP encoder restructure (reference PI0_SIGLIP_BS) -- high risk/effort for ~5ms (SigLIP is only 8% of the 135ms chunk); poor ROI on a single P150. Deferred with this rationale.

resident_sharded_siglip_attempt.outcome: IMPLEMENTED, VALIDATED, MEASURED REGRESSION, REVERTED (not shipped).
resident_sharded_siglip_attempt.grid_for_11x10: (gx=9, gy=8)=72 cores (gcd(36 hidden,144 qkv,135 intermediate)=9; gy=8 divides 8 M-tiles). O-proj K padded 48->54 tiles (not div by 9).
resident_sharded_siglip_attempt.result: resident block-sharded SigLIP is ~18-22% SLOWER at batch=1; PCC fine (0.998). Reverted to interleaved baseline (diff-identical, test re-passes).
resident_sharded_siglip_attempt.root_cause: Sharding amortization needs the M dim to fill the grid. At batch=1, 256 tokens=8 M-tiles -> per_core_M=1 on the 72-core grid (severe underutilization). The per-layer BS<->interleaved reshard round-trip around SDPA (SDPA can't consume block-sharded) dominates, plus the O-proj K-pad (48->54, +12.5% FLOPs) forced by 11x10. The reference's win was tuned for batch=2/512 tokens/16 M-tiles on a 12x8 grid. The existing interleaved baseline already uses full-grid matmuls + (interleaved) LN, so the headroom isn't there at batch=1 on this device.
resident_sharded_siglip_attempt.decision: Confirms the earlier op-sweep negative result with a full resident implementation. Single-P150 batch=1 pi0.5 does not benefit from block-sharded SigLIP. Not shipped.

bfloat4_investigation.outcome: SWEPT, NOT ENABLED (default stays bfloat8_b). Available behind PI05_VLM_MLP_BF4=1.
bfloat4_investigation.decision: bf4 only helps the bandwidth-bound VLM MLP (~1.5ms / ~1% chunk) and HURTS the compute-bound expert. E2E PCC drops 0.9963->0.979 even VLM-only (prefill loss propagates via KV cache through all 10 denoise steps). For a VLA robotics policy, ~1% latency is not worth ~0.017 action-accuracy loss -- matches the reference's choice to use bf8_b (not bf4) for these weights. Default kept at bf8_b; bf4 left as an off-by-default knob.

lofi_fidelity_investigation.outcome: SWEPT, NO CHANGE. LoFi provides no benefit on this model/device.
lofi_fidelity_investigation.decision: LoFi SDPA is same-speed but lower PCC (0.9999->0.9972) -> keep HiFi2 (matches reference PI0_SDPA_HIFI=2). Matmul fidelity is within-noise across LoFi/HiFi2/default -> no change (model uses ttnn default). Root cause: at batch=1 the matmuls are bandwidth/dispatch-bound, not math-throughput-bound, so reducing fidelity frees nothing -- unlike YoloV4's compute-bound convs. No code change.

tracy_device_revalidation.trigger: User flagged that the op-sweep used host wall-clock, not tracy device kernel duration.
tracy_device_revalidation.method: Re-ran the matmul-config sweep UNDER tracy with per-config signposts; read DEVICE KERNEL DURATION per config. Then validated each change by the IN-MODEL traced denoise step (the production metric).

findings.VLM_gate_up: wall-clock said default(119us) best -> WRONG. tracy device: default 303us vs full 135us. FIXED: VLM gate/up now uses full 2D grid. In-model VLM prefill device time 49.6ms->16.1ms.
findings.expert_o_proj: wall-clock said row(22us) best; standalone tracy device said default(32.5us) beats row(58us); but IN-MODEL traced step said row(5.01ms) beats default(5.24ms). Kept ROW -- trust the in-model traced measurement over both standalone benches (concat_heads input layout differs from random-tensor bench).
findings.confirmed_correct: expert down=row (31 vs 65us device), VLM down=full (244 vs 480), SigLIP fc2=full (52 vs 159), expert qkv=row (20.9 vs 22.9), expert gate/up=default.

tracy_device_revalidation.lesson: Metric hierarchy: host wall-clock (pipelined, dispatch-hidden) < standalone tracy device (real kernel, but wrong tensor layout/cache) < IN-MODEL traced step (authoritative for production). Use the in-model traced step to settle config choices.

per_module_bottom_up_pass.method: Tracy-profiled every TTNNModule individually (signpost per module, warmup outside) -> real DEVICE KERNEL DURATION per module + per op. Optimized bottom-up, validating each change by the in-model traced step / E2E PCC.

GemmaMLP_vlm: Unary(gelu) 90us was the 2nd-biggest op after matmul (gelu on 16384-wide intermediate).
SigLIP_Attn: NlpCreateHeads 50us (head_dim 72->96 pad path) -- fixed kernel, not config-tunable.
Suffix_action_out/adarms matmuls ~30us each despite tiny N (fixed overhead-bound; grids won't help N=1 tile).

dispatch_routing_refactor.directive: User: don't call .forward() directly; route through __call__ + @trace_enabled so the framework runtime (signposts, trace capture/replay) works.

Orchestrators (Model/Backbone/Suffix) stay method-based (multi-method/python-loop). Added trace-safe ones-weight for the adaRMS weightless rms_norm (PCC-neutral).

dispatch_routing_refactor.traced_e2e_blocker: Full sample_actions under TT_SYMBIOTE_RUN_MODE=TRACED fails at the expert KV-cache ttnn.concat ('Writes not supported during trace capture') -- the per-block framework trace captures the prefix-KV concat which allocates during capture. Needs static pre-allocated KV buffers + in-place fill (reference's keep_padded path) -- a model change with PCC risk, deferred. The manual whole-forward_expert trace (test_traced_pi05.py) still works as the production trace path.
dispatch_routing_refactor.note: NORMAL mode now incurs per-module dispatch overhead (was bypassed by direct .forward); production benefit is realized under TRACED. Built-in TT_SYMBIOTE_SIGNPOST_MODE supersedes the custom PI05_TRACY_SIGNPOST fixture for module-granularity profiling (fixture kept for per-test segmentation).

static_kv_trace_support.directive: Add KV trace support so the action-expert denoise path is trace-capturable (the prefix-KV ttnn.concat allocated during trace capture and broke it).
static_kv_trace_support.mechanism: Replaced per-call ttnn.concat([past_kv,new_kv]) with a pre-allocated STATIC KV buffer per expert layer [1,1,prefix_len+ahp,256] bf8_b + in-place ttnn.fill_cache writes (allocation-free, trace-safe; update_idx tile-aligned, prefix_len=288=9*32). Prefix region filled once outside the trace from vlm_cache; suffix K/V written in-place at update_idx=prefix_len each step; SDPA reads the full static buffer; phantom mask unchanged.
static_kv_trace_support.wiring: TTNNPi05GemmaAttention.init_static_kv/fill_static_prefix + fill_cache in forward; AdaRMSGemmaBlock delegates; PaliGemmaBackbone.init_expert_static_kv(vlm_cache,...) allocs+prefills 18 layers; Model.sample_actions calls it after VLM prefill, before the denoise loop. Eager concat path kept as fallback.

validation.TRACED_E2E_static_kv: captured 10 step traces + replayed 10 steps @ 5.41ms/step; E2E action PCC (traced-replay vs torch) 0.9973; no 'Writes not supported' from KV path

static_kv_trace_support.remaining_env_framework_blocker: Running sample_actions via TT_SYMBIOTE_RUN_MODE=TRACED (per-block auto warm/capture/replay dispatch) still fails -- but now on ttnn.rms_norm->LayerNormDeviceOperation::load_binaries (a JIT kernel-binary load during capture in the adaRMS _apply_ada), a separate pre-existing framework limitation, NOT the KV path. The explicit begin/end_trace_capture production path (validated above) is unaffected.
static_kv_trace_support.result: KV trace blocker fully resolved. Production trace path (explicit-capture static-KV denoise step, replayed per step) works E2E at PCC 0.9973, ~5.4ms/step.

framework_traced_bottom_up.tier1_submodules: PASS (9/9) -- per-submodule TRACED validation: each @trace_enabled module driven 3x via __call__ under TT_SYMBIOTE_RUN_MODE=TRACED warms->captures->replays (TracedRun.cache grows) with replay PCC>=0.99 vs torch golden. Covers GemmaMLP(vlm,expert), GemmaAttention, GemmaBlock, AdaRMSGemmaBlock, SigLIP MLP/Attn/Block, MMProjector.
framework_traced_bottom_up.mechanism_note: Run impl is bound at import from TT_SYMBIOTE_RUN_MODE (env precedence); set_run_mode is one-shot. The test file is gated to run only under TT_SYMBIOTE_RUN_MODE=TRACED (skipif otherwise) so NORMAL suite is unaffected.
framework_traced_bottom_up.purpose: Confirms the user's point: @trace_enabled on submodules enables fast per-module traced validation. All Tier-1 submodules trace+replay correctly standalone.
framework_traced_bottom_up.tier2_4_status: Tier1 (submodules) + Tier2 (SigLIP tower) PASS under framework TRACED. Tier3 (backbone) is multi-method (forward_vlm/forward_expert -- not a single forward); Tier4 (model.sample_actions) has a python denoise loop + host noise (not one forward) -- both need either a single-forward trace_enabled wrapper or the explicit whole-graph capture (static-KV denoise already 0.9973).
framework_traced_bottom_up.tier2_tower: PASS. Made TTNNPi05SigLIPVisionTower @trace_enabled and added test_traced_siglip_vision_tower: driven 3x under TT_SYMBIOTE_RUN_MODE=TRACED, the WHOLE 27-block tower is captured as ONE trace (child SigLIP blocks run '[Not Trace-Enabled, Already Running Trace Elsewhere]' inside the tower capture) and replayed at PCC 0.9977 vs torch golden. Key: trace at the repeatedly-called module level (tower), not the run-once blocks. NORMAL Tier2/3/4 unaffected (3 passed, E2E PCC 0.9966).
framework_traced_bottom_up.tier3_backbone: PASS. forward_vlm(18-layer Gemma-2B, use_cache=False) wrapped in a single-forward @trace_enabled adapter, driven 3x: whole prefill captured as one trace, replay PCC 0.9969 vs torch (real weights).
framework_traced_bottom_up.tier4_full_model: PASS. Per-step denoise velocity (embed_actions -> forward_expert[static-KV] -> project_output) wrapped in a @trace_enabled adapter, driven over the 10-step Euler loop: step1 warmup, step2 captures the WHOLE step as one trace, steps3-10 replay. E2E action PCC (framework-TRACED vs torch) = 0.9975. KEY FIX: the framework's _copy_inputs_to_trace_buffer only copies TOP-LEVEL ttnn.Tensor args (not nested lists), so per-step adaRMS mods were baked in as step-2's values (E2E PCC -0.33 garbage). Passing all per-step mods as FLAT top-level tensor args (110 tensors) makes each get a trace buffer + per-replay copy -> correct (0.9975).
framework_traced_bottom_up.status: ALL TIERS PASS under framework TT_SYMBIOTE_RUN_MODE=TRACED: Tier1 submodules (9/9), Tier2 SigLIP tower (0.9977), Tier3 backbone VLM prefill (0.9969), Tier4 full denoise E2E (0.9975).
framework_traced_bottom_up.pattern: Trace at the module invoked REPEATEDLY with stable shapes (tower/backbone-prefill/denoise-step via single-forward @trace_enabled adapters); run-once children captured inside via the _TRACE_RUNNING guard. Per-step-varying inputs MUST be flat top-level tensor args (framework input-copy doesn't recurse).

User specified single P150. DeviceArch.P150 exists in core/module.py. Using @run_on_devices(DeviceArch.P150) on all forward() methods (NOT the T3K default). Host has Blackhole p300c boards; single-device mesh.

Reference pi0_5 lives on branch tt/pi0.5_bh (b0703a5), but the installed/built ttnn is main (b2af0cd). Code executes against the installed runtime, so TT_METAL_COMMIT records b2af0cd; reference commit b0703a5 recorded separately. pi05_base weights (~14.5GB, gated) missing and no HF auth. Surfaced to user (genuine credential/resource blocker). User chose to authenticate + download. Scaffold + pcc_test_gen proceed without weights; op_sweep/tracy/perf/config_optimize/traced_execution + Tier-4 semantic validation blocked until weights land.

Key unblock: component (Tier 1/2/3) PCC tests compare TTNN vs torch golden on IDENTICAL random weights, so they validate the port on real P150 hardware WITHOUT the gated checkpoint (mirrors the reference suite's use_pretrained=False path). Only Tier-4 E2E semantic needs real weights. This let the entire transformer core be hardware-validated this session.

Hardware PVE loop caught a real bug: adaRMS modulation slices (scale/shift/gate) were rank-2 (B,w) and didn't broadcast over the seq dim of rank-3 activations. Fixed by reshaping to (B,1,w) in TTNNPi05AdaRMSGemmaBlock._ada_rms_norm and the backbone final adaRMS (matches torch cond.unsqueeze(1)). AdaRMSGemmaBlock then PASSED at PCC>=0.99. Also: action_horizon=50 is not tile-aligned -> Tier-1 adaRMS test uses seq=64 (the full model pads ah to 64).

The ttnn pytest-plugin device/device_params fixtures are NOT loaded in this repo's pytest setup. Adopted the in-repo dots_ocr pattern: a module-scoped 'dev' fixture opening device 0 directly (ttnn.open_device, l1_small_size=24576, trace_region_size=128MiB). @run_on_devices requires MESH_DEVICE=P150 in env -> tests run with MESH_DEVICE=P150.

These stages are deferred, not failed; resume once weights land and sample_actions is completed.

Extended the expert static-KV fill_cache pattern to the VLM: a write-only prefix store lets forward_vlm mirror per-layer K/V in-place instead of returning freshly-allocated persistent K/V, so the cache-building prefill captures+replays. Validated bottom-up Tier1->4 (TRACED) plus NORMAL regression.
